name: One model version
description: A version, its ladders and what it is waiting on. `trial` carries the trial match's own status and how long it has been queued, because a version sits in `verified` while that match is played and would otherwise look stopped -- nothing sweeps a `verified` version, so the wait is made visible rather than cancelled. `class_max_bytes` is read from the version's OWN season, since the caps are per season and a headroom bar must be drawn against the season the version was entered in.

input.query: SELECT json_build_object( 'id', m.id, 'owner', u.handle, 'game', g.slug, 'version', m.version, 'repo', m.repo, 'release_tag', m.release_tag, 'commit_sha', m.commit_sha, 'class', m.weight_class, 'class_max_bytes', (SELECT (e ->> 'max_bytes')::bigint FROM seasons cse, jsonb_array_elements(cse.weight_classes) AS e WHERE cse.id = m.season_id AND e ->> 'class' = m.weight_class::text), 'size_bytes', m.size_bytes, 'param_count', m.param_count, 'infer_us', m.infer_us, 'weights_hash', m.weights_hash, 'adapter_hash', m.adapter_hash, 'evaluator_digest', m.evaluator_digest, 'status', m.status, 'phase', model_phase(m), 'admit_attempt', CASE WHEN m.status = 'testing' THEN m.admit_attempts END, 'successor', (SELECT s.version FROM models s WHERE s.owner_id = m.owner_id AND s.game_id = m.game_id AND s.status = 'active' AND s.season_id = m.season_id AND m.status = 'superseded'), 'reject_reason', m.reject_reason, 'created_at', m.created_at, 'season', (SELECT se.number FROM seasons se WHERE se.id = m.season_id), 'trial', (SELECT json_build_object('match_id', t.id, 'status', t.status, 'preset', t.preset, 'queued_at', t.created_at, 'waiting_s', CASE WHEN t.status = 'pending' THEN round(extract(epoch FROM now() - t.created_at))::bigint END) FROM matches t WHERE t.trial_model_id = m.id ORDER BY t.created_at DESC LIMIT 1), 'ratings', model_ratings(m.id, ($2)::float8), 'baseline', u.role = 'baseline', 'last_played_at', (SELECT max(mt.played_at) FROM match_seats ms JOIN matches mt ON mt.id = ms.match_id WHERE ms.model_id = m.id)) AS body FROM models m JOIN users u ON u.id = m.owner_id JOIN games g ON g.id = m.game_id WHERE m.id = ($1)::uuid
